context.audience: Brazilian Portuguese-speaking Web3 developers and institutional finance operators
conventions: Brazilian Web3 practitioners commonly retain established English product terms.
Standard Brazilian financial vocabulary is preferred when it is familiar to practitioners, such as ativo, contraparte and custódia.
SDP is grammatically feminine: a SDP, da SDP, pela SDP.
Wallet is treated as feminine (a Wallet) and Token as masculine (o Token).
